passed: Independent Redis namespaces do not share temporary state
Broadcast and presence queries reach clients on all four processes
Shared six-action limit, unique sequences and expiring state work across processes
Duplicate joins/leaves and late join retries preserve atomic distinct-user counts
Only one process owns a concurrent background job
Concurrent outbox consumers claim disjoint rows without duplicate normal delivery
Send-before-commit failure retries with the same event ID; deduplicating consumers apply once
Redis outage fails shared-state operations closed
Cross-process queries and broadcasts recover after Redis restarts
One dedicated database leader owns the background-job runner
Process death releases the database job lock and permits takeover
Background leader ownership transfers after the elected process dies
